topic: What feed element spacing balance minimizes dB loss while maintaining beamforming flexibility in defocused systems?
consensus_response: Optimal feed element spacing balances dB loss and beamforming flexibility by minimizing interference. Element directivity reduces mutual coupling, increasing capacity, but may compromise beamforming flexibility due to reduced element spacing tolerances. Frequency bandwidth introduces dispersion, affecting mutual coupling and beamforming complexity.
reference_context: SatCom systems optimize feed element spacing to minimize dB loss and maintain beamforming flexibility, considering factors like max beam gain, throughput per beam, and array geometry.
